messages:
anna: FYI support alert — starting ~03:40UTC we're seeing a global spike of 401s from the hosted API after last night's key rotation job (deploy-879). Customers reporting: 'api returns 401 when using existing API keys'. Root logs show 'invalid token: kid not found' from auth-service. Escalating to eng-sre @praveen @sarah

praveen: grabbing logs now. can you paste a curl sample and a few request IDs? also which routing region is most affected?

anna: curl sample and request IDs below, majority from us-west and eu-west. affected customers: one large marketplace and few mid-market PLG apps. request ids: rQ8a7, rQ8a9, rQ8b0

anna: ```
curl -i https://api.redwood.example/v1/completions 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-live-xyz" 
  -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'

HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
{
  "error": "invalid_token",
  "message": "kid not found"
}
```

sarah: looking at auth-service metrics — JWKS fetch error rate spiked right around the rotation window (03:35UTC). upstream jwks-cache returned 502 for ~4m. auth-service then started rejecting tokens because the new key id (kid) wasn't present in the cached JWKS.

maria: infra timeline — rotation job applied new signing key to key-management and updated internal db/kid reference at 03:34:55, but the public JWKS CDN edge cache (TTL 60s) had a propagation lag and several edges returned 504/502 until 03:38:30. Looks like rotation script didn't wait for full cache propagation before flipping production reference.

eli: oncall — can we re-add the previous key entry to JWKS so older tokens validate? If we can, we can reduce customer impact quickly.

maria: attempting temporary re-add of previous JWKS entry to the origin. If CDN has cached 502 it won't help all edges but most should pickup new origin within 60-120s.

deploy-bot: job deploy-879: rotation completed (success). job id: deploy-879, started 03:33:12, finished 03:34:56. no post-checks failed in deployment pipeline (post-checks didn't verify global jwks propagation).

praveen: temporary mitigation plan: 1) re-add old key to origin JWKS (maria), 2) update auth-service to accept both old and new kid for 15 minutes (sarah/praveen), 3) pause rotation pipeline and mark job as incident-blocked (eli). also notify support for customer outreach.

maria: origin updated — old kid re-added at 03:40:20. pushing cache purge to edge points for eu/us regions now.

sarah: pushing a hotfix to auth-service to tolerate multiple kids and fallback verification for 20m. rolling 10% canary now.

oncall-bot: incident INC-2345 created: auth-key-rotation-propagation-stall. Severity: SEV2. Paging oncall.

anna: support notes: initiated proactive outreach to affected customers, offering 2 days of credits and status updates. escalation cases opened: CS-1029, CS-1031. customers want timeline + root cause.

eli: paused rotation pipeline and marked deploy-879 as failed/blocked at 03:41:00. rollback option discussed but preference is to rehydrate JWKS and keep service up — less churn for customers.

sarah: canary looks good — errors dropped 70% on canary nodes. after full roll we should see traffic normalize. keep an eye on latency spike from extra verification paths.

maria: CDN purge completed for primary edges at 03:45:10, propagation confirmed for ~85% edges.

praveen: monitoring: auth 401 rate peaked at 03:39UTC and returned to baseline by 03:52UTC after mitigations. rolling metrics attached to incident INC-2345 (graphs: jwks-fetch-5xx, auth-401-rate, rotation-job-timestamps).

anna: customers reporting partial restoration. still seeing small remaining spikes from APAC edges.

maria: APAC edges showing slower origin refresh due to regional peering route; doing targeted purge and will keep old key in origin until tomorrow 06:00UTC to be safe.

praveen: root cause summary so far: rotation script updated service reference before verifying global JWKS propagation. missing propagation check + CDN TTL assumptions caused short window where tokens signed with old kid couldn't be validated because JWKS edges returned errors or didn't include new kid.

eli: immediate remediation completed: origin rehydration, auth-service tolerant verification, rotation pipeline paused. Next steps: patch rotation script to poll JWKS across a set of edge points and only flip reference after 2 consecutive successful fetches, add CI check, and make rotation pipeline require a manual approval for high-impact rotations.

sarah: repro notes for postmortem: steps to reproduce locally and in staging: 1) flip key on origin 2) simulate jwks-edge 502 for X seconds 3) flip service config -> observe 401s. Put reproduction script in incident repo inc/2345/repro.sh.

praveen: customer impact & comms: support has an email draft. we also need a public status update and an opt-in creds compensation plan for affected customers. assigning comms to @anna and @maria to coordinate.

maria: blocking action items created: ACTION-INC2345-1 (patch rotation script), ACTION-INC2345-2 (add global jwks propagation smoke test), ACTION-INC2345-3 (update runbook for rotation), ACTION-INC2345-4 (postmortem + timeline), ACTION-INC2345-5 (verify billing/no double-charges for affected tokens).

oncall-bot: incident severity lowered to SEV3 at 04:00UTC.

anna: final customer-facing note scheduled for 05:00UTC after RCA draft. postmortem owners: praveen (tech lead), anna (customer comms), maria (infra).

eli: timeline to close: produce RCA + runbook updates within 72h, complete rotation script patch in next sprint, confirm edge TTL documentation updates.

praveen: thanks everyone — reopening this thread for any late reports. I'll attach logs and a small diagram of the propagation-check we'll add to the rotation job.

anna: closing interim thread — will update when postmortem published. :thumbsup:
